_comment: One entry per integration: one Logic App, one managed identity, one custom task extension. Fictional values for contoso.example. A change here changes what a lifecycle workflow can make another system do; review it like code.

integrations.name: cms-revocation
integrations.description: Revoke the leaver's PIV credential in the card management system (Book 03, Chapter 09, the canonical leaver sequence, step 3).

workflows.book03: Leaver: revoke credentials after the block

extension.description: Calls la-lcw-cms-revocation and waits for its callback.
